summary: Cloud Configs & Share Codes, GUI Themes, XBow Delays, StreamProof Fullscreen & Combat Fixes

changes.title: Cloud Configs & Share Codes
changes.detail: Browse community presets in-game with one-click Add, Refresh, and Update, plus clipboard CFG1 share-code copy and import

changes.title: GUI Appearance & Themes
changes.detail: Added Obsidian, Emerald, Midnight Violet, Ocean Blue, Crimson, and Custom themes with accent/panel color, opacity, blur, dim, and UI scale

changes.title: XBow Stage Delays & TriggerBot Miss Chance
changes.detail: Added per-stage XBow timing sliders, TriggerBot quick-swap cooldown tracking, and a Miss Chance slider

changes.title: PearlCatch, PearlGrapple & StreamProof Fullscreen
changes.detail: Fixed PearlCatch Legit Mode and eliminated solver lag spikes, aligned MC 1.21.11 pearl physics, fixed SilentAim strafe snap, TotemHit silent swap, and StreamProof fullscreen stability
